lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid. Local maxima are distributed with higher density in the mid-flank region, transitioning to smaller, more frequent clusters anteriorly towards the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with longitudinal ridges to define a grid-like matrix. The highest intensity circular blobs are primarily centered within the quadrangular spaces formed by these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible running parallel along the upper lateral flank. These are defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance values on the upper ridge edge and shadow-induced low-luminance values immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of high-luminance spots is visible within the dorsal fin silhouette. The spots are smaller and less regular in shape compared to the flank constellations, with a higher spatial frequency observed towards the posterior margin of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several elongated, irregular white linear features are present on the dorsal-lateral surface, oriented diagonally to the main body axis. These features do not conform to the primary geometric pattern and represent superficial dermal markings or healed abrasions.
